# 00000004382

**KK2-22 ★** — source: 131_代数K理论II_迹方法.md

**English.** Definition: The Andre-Quillen cohomology of the topological modular forms spectrum tmf is the graded deformation cohomology of tmf as an E-infinity ring. Conjecture: The AQ cohomology is generated by the weight-12 modular form Delta with generator degree differences always 12; the part of weight at most 24 is a polynomial ring in Delta with trivial Z-module coefficients; above weight 24, 2-torsion and 3-torsion appear and the order of the torsion part divides 24. (tmf AQ generation with weight difference 12)

**中文。** 定义：拓扑模形式谱 tmf 的 André–Quillen 余上同调：tmf 作为 E 无穷环的形变上同调分次。猜想：AQ 余上同调由权 12 的模形式 Δ 生成且生成元的度差恒为 12；权不超过 24 的部分为 Δ 的多项式环且系数群为平凡 Z 模；权 24 以上出现 2 挠与 3 挠且挠部分的阶整除 24。（tmf AQ 生成权差 12）
